_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

card_product.name: Bandhan Bank Sparks Credit Card
card_product.point_value_baseline_basis: Bandhan Bank Delights FAQ, Accrual: 1 Delight Point = INR 0.25; the Bank may change the value from time to time. Card-page Value Charts use the same 0.25 (Sparks: 500 activation points = INR 125; Ignite: 1,000 points = INR 250). Minimum redemption 400 points; no convenience fee (FAQ). FAQ page is undated.

action.reason: Rent, fuel and government-sector MCCs earn no reward points (Excluded Merchant Category Codes list, 23 Jun 2026).
4 reward points per ₹200 on grocery and apparel (Compare page); accelerated points capped at 400 a month (Product Usage Guide).
2 reward points per ₹200 on all categories (Compare page; Product Usage Guide base rate).

open_questions: Delights earn rules and redemption catalogue sit behind the Delights login ("About Delights"); only the FAQ value (INR 0.25 per point, minimum 400 points to redeem) was readable without signing in. The FAQ is undated and says the Bank may change the value.

The card-page Value Charts do not reconcile with the stated base rates for the "all other transactions" line (for example Lumina shows INR 4,800 a year on INR 1,00,000 monthly spend, which is about 0.4%, against 16 points per INR 200 at INR 0.25 = 2%). The stated base rate is used and the charts are treated as illustrations.

Network: not stated for Sparks in any issuer document read. The MITC and KFS say Flash (RuPay) is issued only to existing physical Visa or Mastercard cardholders, which is a statement about the physical cards as a family; the Product Usage Guide names Visa, Mastercard and RuPay lounge lists for "eligible" cards without saying which applies to Sparks. Card art on the issuer site shows no network logo. card_product.network is left null and no network candidates are recorded; a person must read it off the issued card or the application flow.

Accelerated-reward cap: the Product Usage Guide says "per month" without saying calendar month or statement cycle; calendar_month is assumed (milestones are stated per calendar month). The cap value matches the Value Chart arithmetic (cap points x 12 x INR 0.25), so it is read as total accelerated points, not bonus-only.
Interest on purchases is 3.5% a month for new-to-bank customers; existing-to-bank customers get 3.5% a month (42% a year) (MITC and KFS agree). The draft uses the new-to-bank rate.
MITC document reference CC/MITC/OA/090726/03/V-01; the file is dated 19 Aug 2026.
notes: Rewards are "Delight Points" and never expire (home page: never-expiring rewards).
Rewards earn no points on the MCCs in the Excluded Merchant Category Codes list (rent, fuel, government sector); the same list also bars those MCCs from EMI conversion (Product Usage Guide).
Milestone and activation offers are event bonuses (spend within 30 days, or monthly spend), so they are not modelled as spend rates: Sparks has no monthly milestone.

MITC also lists a fifth variant, "Flash": a fully digital RuPay credit card issued only to existing physical Visa or Mastercard cardholders, sharing the physical card's credit limit on a separate card account, with no POS use. Joining and renewal fee nil; interest 3.5% a month (42% a year); forex 3.5%; fuel waiver 1% up to INR 150 a cycle on INR 500-2,500; no accelerated rewards, base 2 points per INR 200 (MITC, KFS, Product Usage Guide). It is not drafted here because it is not a standalone product.
